title: Object Storage: outage authorize — cash credit account remainder
content:
For Object Storage outage authorize, for the refund, sum amount of all posted storage billed service amounts on this holding; this is a complete holding account remainder calculation. Add the signed amount of all posted bank-confirmed storage remittances on this holding. Add the signed amount of all posted storage credit postings on this holding, including the completed outage concession. Add positive amounts of all posted prior storage cash payouts on this holding. Add positive amounts of all posted bank payment bank reversals on this holding. Add positive amounts of all posted debit adjustments on this holding. Negate the sum of billed service amounts, remittances, credit postings, cash payouts, bank reversals and debit adjustments, and floor at zero to obtain the cash credit account remainder.

Negate the sum of billed service amounts, remittances, credit postings, cash payouts, bank reversals and debit adjustments, and floor at zero to obtain the cash credit account remainder.

## Hypothetical outage authorize — cash credit account remainder case

For this outage authorize — cash credit account remainder example, assume hypothetical posted holding totals: billed service amounts USD 400, signed remittances negative USD 450, signed credit postings negative USD 30, cash payouts USD 8, bank reversals USD 7 and upward adjustments USD 5. The signed sum is negative USD 60; its negation gives a cash credit account remainder of USD 60.
